title: On the range of fractional parts {ξ(p/q)^n}
notes: docs/problems/juggler_three_halves_mod_one.md. Acta Arithmetica 70 (1995) 125-147. Omega(p/q) > 1/p, hence limsup {(3/2)^n} - liminf {(3/2)^n} >= 1/3. Expanding-map symbolic dynamics, not irrational rotation. Also the classical Collatz adjacency for {xi (3/2)^n}.
